topic: Talking to a Neighbor About the Lawn

script.title: OVER THE FENCE
script.scene_zh: 院內圍籬 · 鄰居聊天
script.story_hook: A new neighbor has one small leaf problem.
script.intro_zh: 新鄰居帶著一個小小的落葉問題上門。
script.welcome_en: Today we chat over a fence with a neighbor. Listen and learn!
script.welcome_zh: 今天我們隔著圍籬和鄰居聊天。仔細聽、仔細學！
script.outro: That's how a leaf problem turns into a friendship. Well done!
script.outro_zh: 落葉問題就這樣變成了友誼。做得好！
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat the friendly neighbor phrases with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟我重唸鄰居友善常用句。
script.char_a_description: a cheerful young Black man in his early twenties with a short buzz cut and a neat beard, wearing a faded green hoodie, gray sweat shorts, work gloves tucked in his pocket, and bright orange running shoes
script.char_b_description: a stocky white man in his late sixties with a thinning silver mullet and round wire glasses, wearing a red plaid flannel shirt with rolled sleeves, khaki cargo pants, and brown leather work boots

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning! You must be Gene next door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ ju məst bi ɡin nɛkst dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 早安！您一定是住在隔壁的吉恩先生吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am. The young guy from the corner house?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ðə jʌŋ ɡaɪ fɚm ði ˈkɔrnɚ haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 是我。角落那戶新來的年輕人？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Marco. I just moved in last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑrkoʊ aɪ dʒʌst ˈmuvd ɪn læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 我是馬可，上個月才剛搬進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome, Marco. Lemonade's cold, company's free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm ˈmɑrkoʊ ˌlɛməˈneɪdz koʊld ˈkʌmpəniz fri/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎啊馬可。檸檬汁是冰的，陪伴是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Actually, I came over about your maple.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæ ˈæktʃuəli aɪ keɪm ˈoʊvɚ əˈbaʊt jʊr ˈmeɪpəl/
dialogue.zh: 哈！其實，我是為了你那棵楓樹走過來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Uh-oh. The leaves again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌ ˈoʊ ðə livz əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，又是落葉的問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That big tree drops tons in my yard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bɪɡ tri drɑps tʌnz ɪn maɪ jɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 那棵大樹在我院子裡掉超多葉子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That old maple's a beast. Sorry, neighbor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt oʊld ˈmeɪpəlz ə bist ˈsɑri ˈneɪbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那棵老楓樹真是怪獸，抱歉啊鄰居。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No worries. Mostly the fence-side strip.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜriz ˈmoʊstli ðə ˈfɛns saɪd strɪp/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係啦，主要是圍籬旁邊那一長條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll rake it Saturday morning. Fair?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ reɪk ɪt ˈsætɚˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 我星期六早上幫你耙乾淨，這樣公道吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You don't have to... but thank you!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju doʊnt hæv tə bʌt θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 其實你不用這麼做……但還是很感謝你！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neighbors help neighbors. Always have around here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈneɪbərz hɛlp ˈneɪbərz ˈɔlˌweɪz hæv əˈraʊnd hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 鄰居就是要互相幫忙，這一带向來如此。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Funny, I spotted something on your side, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfʌni aɪ ˈspɑtɪd ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɑn jʊr saɪd tu/
dialogue.zh: 好巧，你那一邊我也有個小發現。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My hedge? Getting a little wild, huh?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hɛdʒ ˈɡɛtɪŋ ə ˈlɪtəl waɪld hʌ/
dialogue.zh: 我的樹籬？長得有點亂了，是吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shades my tomato plants, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃeɪdz maɪ təˈmeɪtoʊ plænts ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 說實話，它擋住了我番茄苗的陽光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh man. My trimmer died last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ mæn maɪ ˈtrɪmɚ daɪd læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 唉，我的修剪機上禮拜壞掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bummer. Was it working this spring?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌmɚ wʌz ɪt ˈwɜrkɪŋ ðɪs sprɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好可惜。它今年春天還好好的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blew its motor. My knees aren't great either.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu ɪts ˈmoʊtɚ maɪ niz ɑrənt ɡreɪt ˈiðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 馬達燒掉了。我的膝蓋也不中用啦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, my brother's got a strong electric one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl maɪ ˈbrʌðɚz ɡɑt ə strɔŋ ɪˈlɛktrɪk wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 這樣啊，我哥有一臺很強的電動修剪機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'd lend it to me? That's mighty kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /jud lɛnd ɪt tə mi ðæts ˈmaɪti kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 你願意借我？人真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better yet, he can trim it Sunday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər jɛt hi kæn trɪm ɪt ˈsʌndeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 更好的安排是：他週日早上來幫你修剪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you serious? That'd be a huge help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈsɪriəs ðæd bi ə hjuːd hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 真的假的？那真是幫了大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No problem. We'll clear every clipping together.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm wil klɪr ˈɛvri ˈklɪpɪŋ təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，我們一起把剪下來的枝葉清乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're on, then. Sunday, nine a.m.?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ɑn ðɛn ˈsʌndeɪ naɪn ˌeɪˈɛm/
dialogue.zh: 那就說定了。週日早上九點？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine's perfect. I'll bring gloves and music.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪnz ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪl brɪŋ ɡlʌvz ænd ˈmjuːzɪk/
dialogue.zh: 九點正好。我帶手套和音響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll make iced tea. The big jug.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ meɪk aɪst ti ðə bɪɡ dʒʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我來煮冰茶，煮那一大壺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make it two jugs. My brother talks a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk ɪt tu dʒʌɡz maɪ ˈbrʌðɚ tɔks ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 煮兩壺吧。我哥很愛講話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! We've got all day. No rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ wiv ɡɑt ɔl deɪ noʊ rʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！我們一整天都有時間，慢慢來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, and one tiny favor, if it's okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ænd wʌn ˈtaɪni ˈfeɪvɚ ɪf ɪts oˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 喔，還有個小請求，方便的話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. Shoot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ʃut/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，請說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your sprinkler soaks my grill every afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈsprɪŋklɚ suks maɪ ɡrɪl ˈɛvri ˈæftɚˌnun/
dialogue.zh: 你的灑水器每天下午都把我家烤爐噴得濕透。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does it? That timer goes crazy, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt ðæt ˈtaɪmɚ goʊz ˈkreɪzi ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 是嗎？那個定時器真的常發瘋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It did yesterday. Charcoal soup, basically.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪd ˈjɛstɚˌdeɪ ˈtʃɑrkoʊl suːp ˈbeɪsɪkli/
dialogue.zh: 昨天就是這樣。炭爐直接變炭湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two-minute fix. I'll turn it after breakfast.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪnɪt fɪks aɪl tɜrn ɪt ˈæftɚ ˈbrɛkfəst/
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘就能搞定。我吃完早餐就把它轉過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver, Gene. Seriously, thanks.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ ɡin ˈsɪriəsli θæŋks/
dialogue.zh: 你真是我的救星，吉恩。說真的，謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, hard truth. That maple lifted your fence.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ hɑrd truːθ ðæt ˈmeɪpəl ˈlɪftɪd jʊr fɛns/
dialogue.zh: 還有個壞消息。那棵楓樹把你家的圍籬頂高了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The leaning post? I blamed winter freeze.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlinɪŋ poʊst aɪ bleɪmd ˈwɪntɚ friz/
dialogue.zh: 那根歪的柱子？我還以為是冬天結冰弄的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow roots. We'll reset it Sunday, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /sloʊ ruːts wil rɪˈsɛt ɪt ˈsʌndeɪ tu/
dialogue.zh: 是樹根慢慢推的。我們週日一併扶正。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, you thought of everything!
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ju θɔt ʌv ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哇，你什麼都想到了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty years here. The fence is my hobby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti jɪrz hɪr ðə fɛns ɪz maɪ ˈhɑbi/
dialogue.zh: 我住在這四十年啦。整修圍籬就是我的嗜好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! My lawn's my shame, to be fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ maɪ lɔnz maɪ ʃeɪm tə bi fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 哈！說公道的，我的草地才讓我看見羞恥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New grass seed, right? I've got a spare bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ɡræs sid raɪt aɪv ɡɑt ə spɛr bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 是要補草種對吧？我多一包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You do? Then you really are a wizard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju du ðɛn ju ˈrɪli ɑr ə ˈwɪzɚrd/
dialogue.zh: 真的有？那你根本是法師。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take half. It's in my shed by the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk hæf ɪts ɪn maɪ ʃɛd baɪ ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 拿一半去吧。就在我門邊的小倉庫裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I owe you one, Gene. Coffee next?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ oʊ ju wʌn ɡin ˈkɔfi nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 我欠你一趟，吉恩。下次換我請咖啡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! I'll bring the tea. You bring chairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ aɪl brɪŋ ðə ti ju brɪŋ tʃɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 哈！我帶茶，你帶椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Hey, when does the yard cleanup run?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil heɪ wɛn dʌz ðə jɑrd ˈklip ˌʌn rʌn/
dialogue.zh: 成交。對了，院子大清運什麼時候辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow. Brown bags are behind my car.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ braʊn bæɡz ɑr bɪˈhaɪnd maɪ kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 明天。棕色收集袋就放在我車後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing. And your branches scrape my paint.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ ænd jʊr ˈbrɑnʧɪz skreɪp maɪ peɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 時間剛剛好。還有你的樹枝會刮到我的油漆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll angle those back. No problem at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil ˈæŋɡəl ðoʊz bæk noʊ ˈprɑbləm æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 我們把那幾枝往後修。完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, leaves happen every single fall, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl livz ˈhæpənz ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl fɔl raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，每年秋天總會有落葉，是吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And good neighbors fix them together. Right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɡʊd ˈneɪbərz fɪks ðɛm təˈɡɛðɚ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 而好鄰居會一起把它們處理好。對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right! Sunday, nine. See you over the fence.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈsʌndeɪ naɪn si ju ˈoʊvɚ ðə fɛns/
dialogue.zh: 對！週日九點，圍籬邊見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you, Marco. Tell your brother to dress warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈmɑrkoʊ tɛl jʊr ˈbrʌðɚ tə drɛs wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 回見，馬可。叫你哥穿暖一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He'll love that. He's always cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /hil lʌv ðæt hiz ˈɔlweɪz koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 他會愛這句的。他永遠覺得冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring his rake too, if that's alright.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ hɪz reɪk tu ɪf ðæts ɔˈraɪt/
dialogue.zh: 方便的話也把他的耙子帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already in my trunk. Prepared, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi ɪn maɪ trʌŋk prɪˈpɛrd raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 已經放我車後廂了。我準備很週到吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what fences are for, kid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wʌt ˈfɛnsɚz ɑr fɔr kɪd/
dialogue.zh: 年輕人，圍籬就是為這個而存在的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nine sharp, Gene. Thanks again!
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ʃɑrp ɡin θæŋks əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 九點整，吉恩。再謝謝你！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you Sunday, Marco. Bright and early.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈsʌndeɪ ˈmɑrkoʊ braɪt ænd ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 週日見，馬可。一大早就開工。

script.youtube_description:
鄰居的大楓樹掉滿你院子，英文該怎麼客氣開口？
這一集是60句完整的鄰居對話：客氣反映、約時間修剪、順道聊天、交換小道具，從落葉一路聊到變朋友。

你會學到：
・ 客氣又自然的反映句型（I came over about your maple）
・ 約時間與臨時小請求（Sunday, nine a.m.?）
・ 道謝與收尾閒聊（You're a lifesaver. See you over the fence.）

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，不用背，多聽就會用。

訂閱我們，和每個鄰居都聊得起來！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
The big maple next door is burying your yard in leaves. What do you say, in friendly English?
This episode is one full 60-line fence-side chat: raising it politely, planning a hedge trim, fixing the sprinkler, and leaving as friends.

You will hear:
・ soft, polite neighbor complaints
・ making plans with days and times
・ small favors and warm thanks

The second half is line-by-line listening and repeat-after-me practice. No memorizing - just listen, and it sticks.

Subscribe for more everyday English that makes friends next door!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
鄰居的楓樹掉滿你的院子，怎麼開口才不失禮？
約週日修剪，英文時間要怎麼說？
這一集帶大家走進週末的院子圍籬邊，新鄰居和老鄰居從落葉聊到樹籬，再聊成朋友。

你會聽到：
🍁「Actually, I came over about your maple.」客氣開口的技巧
🌿「Better yet, he can trim it Sunday morning.」熱心提議的說法
🚿「Your sprinkler soaks my grill every afternoon.」順道反映小問題
🤝「And good neighbors fix them together.」 neighbor 的溫暖金句

script.thumbnail_action: leaning on the fence waving hello
